summary: Toggleable outline for either a mesh or a sprite, using whichever renderer is present.
overview: An outline you can switch on and off, working with a MeshRenderer or a SpriteRenderer depending on what is on the object — assign the matching outline material. The outline material is appended to the renderer rather than replacing the existing one.
useCases: Highlighting a selected unit or interactable.
Showing what is under the cursor.

params.tuning: There are two shaders — one for 3D meshes, one for sprites. The wrong one produces no visible outline rather than an error.

gotchas.title: Appending a material adds a draw call
gotchas.body: Which is how it outlines without replacing the object's look. Highlighting hundreds of objects at once is not free.
